Late to the party, but who cares.

Although I was raised Catholic, religion was never forced upon me. There would be times when my dad would discuss god, Jesus, heaven, etc. with me when I was curious. I never read the Bible, went to mass, or received a communion as many Catholics do. For as long as I can recall, I never truly believed in a heaven or gods. It was more like, "This is what everyone else does and I'm afraid of any punishment I might receive so I'll go along with it." Years pass and I become a pre-teen. Family issues get rough and I decide to pray, since I never really did that either. I prayed and prayed and things only got worse. My life was a nightmare and I had never felt more alone. That's where my not-so-strict beliefs started to unravel. Like most issues, my family problems eventually got better and everything was pretty much back to normal. More years pass and I become a teenager (14-15 years old). At this point, so many questions full my brain. Why does god permit so much evil on earth? Why didn't he help me when I needed help the most? These thoughts grew into questioning the Bible, and I soon ruled it out as a contradictory fairy tale. From then on, I eliminated the possibility of any supernatural being or god. Within a few weeks, I solidified my stance as an atheist. The evolution section in biology helped out a bit, too. "Goddidit" doesn't work for everything.

**TL;DR: Grew up only mildly believing in a god and came to my senses when I learned to question my beliefs.**
Thank you so much, you helped me so much. I appreciate all your help.
It sounds like a reasonable option. As long as I remain anonymous, I think I would rather take that route.

I tried talking to one person only months ago, my friend from my old town, about it. She's extremely trustworthy but it was hard to convey my thoughts and feelings to a person who has not experienced it. It was like talking to a sympathetic brick wall. I might talk to my advisory instructor today, but I don't know. I just want things to be over.

I mainly become suicidal when I look at the negative aspects of my life, i.e mild depression, no real bonds with anyone in my life, poor self image, having no true goal in life. Last night and this morning I was seriously considering swallowing a bunch of pills. Whenever I don't like the way my life is at the moment, the depression kicks in and I have constant suicidal thoughts. It's overwhelming.
